parser:
import re

def parse(lines):
    rows = []
    used = []
    st = []
    stused = []
    f = ''
    s = ''
    p = ''
    for i, l in enumerate(lines):
        if not l.strip():
            continue
        m = re.match(r'^(?P<f>\S.*?)\s+(?P<st>syntax OK|had compilation errors.*?)\s*$', l)
        if m:
            st.append({'File': m.group('f'), 'Status': m.group('st')})
            stused.append(i)
            continue
        m = re.match(r'^File\s+(?P<v>\S.*?)\s*$', l)
        if m:
            f = m.group('v'); s = ''; p = ''
            used.append(i)
            continue
        m = re.match(r'^\s+Subroutine\s+(?P<v>\S.*?)\s*$', l)
        if m:
            s = m.group('v'); p = ''
            used.append(i)
            continue
        m = re.match(r'^\s+Package\s+(?P<v>\S.*?)\s*$', l)
        if m:
            p = m.group('v')
            used.append(i)
            continue
        m = re.match(r'^\s+(?P<sym>\S+)\s+(?P<refs>\S.*?)\s*$', l)
        if m:
            rows.append({'File': f, 'Subroutine': s, 'Package': p, 'Symbol': m.group('sym'), 'Lines': m.group('refs')})
            used.append(i)
            continue
    blocks = []
    if st:
        blocks.append({'name': 'status', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': stused, 'records': st})
    if rows:
        blocks.append({'name': 'symbols', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': used, 'records': rows})
    return {'blocks': blocks, 'skip': []}

fixes: Line 0 ('slug.pl syntax OK') is the compile status of the file, and the tables hold it nowhere. The template also sets aside the '<file> had compilation errors' form, which would drop an error. Stop skipping these lines. Emit them as a separate 'status' block with columns `File` (the text before ' syntax OK' or ' had compilation errors') and `Status` (the rest of the line, e.g. 'syntax OK'), and list the line in that block's lines. Alternatively, carry the status onto the symbols rows of the same file as a `Status` column.

examples:
slug.pl syntax OK
File slug.pl
  Subroutine (main)
    Package (lexical)
      $count            i5
      %translit         i4
    Package main
      &report           &26
  Subroutine report
    Package (lexical)
      $count            23
      $n                23
      @words            i18, 20, 21
    Package main
      $_                21
      &slugify          &21
  Subroutine slugify
    Package (lexical)
      $count            13
      $s                14
      $sep              i8, 9, 11, 12, 12
      $text             i8, 10
